read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table, capability and decision log
input: FSim fire intensity class at the unit, exact integer 1 to 6 (0 = no event); no interpolation, heat-flux conversion or burn probability in the Damage call

how_to_use.share_of: Hardware value of the same physical unit, fixed 2024 dollars: $1.05M per integrated enclosure (80), $520,000 per PCS (20); $94.4M covered of $109.8M total

outputs.single_event: conditional: exact class 0 to 6 plus an explicit consequence choice and curve shape; repair choices also need a serviceability counterfactual
outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: same conditions, with the same-unit value; no blanket exposure or protection multiplier
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: Hazard computes it only after source exposure, shared-event dependence, per-unit cap and annual-distribution checks pass; partial-property result only

conditions: Pin the exact model v1.0 / docs r1 artifact, capability and value
No default consequence or shape: choose one; options are unweighted and must not be averaged
Burn probability stays with Hazard; unknown class is unavailable, never the no-event class
Cap each unit's yearly cost at its value; no repair within the year
The $15.4M unbound property is not zero

method.summary: Solar wildfire electrical class tables reused as T4 ordinal weights on FSim class, times an owner-selected consequence ($1.05M enclosure replacement, with two repair sensitivities)

key_sources: Selected BESS r1 profile and fixed-2024 budget (BWF-S01)
USFS, A Wildfire Risk Assessment Framework, RMRS-GTR-315 (2013), FSim classes (BWF-S02)
Canonical wildfire_solar model v1.0 docs r3 (BWF-S03)
Tesla Industrial Lithium-Ion Battery Emergency Response Guide rev 2.8 (BWF-S04)
Sungrow, A Holistic Approach to Safety whitepaper (BWF-S05)
judgment: Enclosure class weights borrowed from the solar wildfire electrical tables; not ignition probabilities (BWF-P07)
A compromised battery means full $1.05M enclosure replacement (BWF-Q01)
Repair costs (about $334k and $204k) come from a related cost split (BWF-P08)
PCS uses the solar electronics table unchanged (BWF-P09)
No protection credit, exposed-share default or random damage draw (BWF-P10)
open_items: Matched fire exposure, duration and inspected repair costs still needed
Yard fuel transfer, real fire footprints and spread between units not modelled
$15.4M of mixed electrical, civil and fieldwork value has no response yet

rows.variants: consequence: approved replacement / non-cell repair / limited repair; shape: electronics or heavy-electrical (unweighted)
rows.shape_basis: Solar electrical class tables transferred as ordinal weights (BWF-P07)
rows.cost_basis: Owner-selected replacement and cost-split repair amounts (BWF-P08)

notes.text: Repair versions need an explicit serviceability counterfactual
Class weights are economic mean responses, not ignition probabilities

rows.cost_basis: Donor table is already a share of value (T4), applied to $520,000

notes.text: wildfire_solar v1.0 docs r3 electronics table
